title: Range Module
subtitle: 3x3 or 5x5 chunks
text:
A Range Module widens a Chunk Loader by one chunk each way. Fit it next to the loader, two at most.

Loader alone: 1x1, 1 chunk, 32 FE/t.
One Range: 3x3, 9 chunks, 288 FE/t.
Two Range: 5x5, 25 chunks, 800 FE/t.
All of them fit on LV. Overlapping loaders each pay for their own area.

Each player can load 75 chunks. Past that a loader shows Over limit and the device works without loading. Server owners can change the cap, the FE per chunk and offline loading in config/simplemachines-server.properties.
caption: Bigger area, bigger draw
